In the fictional "Odd Island", all the numbers contain only odd digits. The order of the counting numbers is the following:

1, 3, 5, 7, …, 19, 31, 33, …

What is the 55th counting number in the island?
questions.body_id:
Di pulau fiksi "Pulau Ganjil", semua bilangan hanya memiliki angka ganjil. Urutan bilangan cacahnya adalah sebagai berikut:

1, 3, 5, 7, …, 19, 31, 33, …

Berapakah bilangan cacah ke-55 di pulau tersebut?

strategy.name_id: Hitung berdasarkan panjang digit, lalu cari posisi dalam kelompok

hint_steps_en: Odd digits are: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. One-digit odd-digit numbers: 1,3,5,7,9 → 5 numbers (positions 1–5)
Two-digit odd-digit numbers: each digit has 5 choices → 5×5 = 25 numbers (positions 6–30)
The 55th number is in the 3-digit group; its position within 3-digit numbers is 55 − 30 = 25th
Three-digit numbers: first digit from {1,3,5,7,9}, rest same. First 25 are those starting with 1: 111, 113, 115, 117, 119, 131, 133, …, 199
The 25th number starting with 1 is 199 (5×5 = 25, last is 199). Answer is D
hint_steps_id: Angka ganjil: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Bilangan 1-digit angka ganjil: 1,3,5,7,9 → 5 bilangan (posisi 1–5)
Bilangan 2-digit angka ganjil: setiap digit punya 5 pilihan → 5×5 = 25 bilangan (posisi 6–30)
Bilangan ke-55 ada di kelompok 3-digit; posisinya dalam kelompok 3-digit adalah 55 − 30 = ke-25
Bilangan 3-digit: digit pertama dari {1,3,5,7,9}, selebihnya sama. 25 yang pertama diawali angka 1: 111, 113, 115, 117, 119, 131, …, 199
Bilangan ke-25 yang diawali 1 adalah 199 (5×5 = 25, terakhir adalah 199). Jawaban D

hint_steps_en: First column (below 10): 12+14+16+18 = 60; total first col including corner = 70

Each interior cell = (column header) + (row header). Sum of interior = (sum of col headers without 10) × (sum of row headers without 10) = (11+13+15+17+19) × (12+14+16+18) = 75 × 60 = ... Actually: sum of interior = (sum of col tops excl. 10) × 1 per row × (number of rows) is wrong. Use: each interior cell is col_top + row_left. Sum of all interior = 4×(11+13+15+17+19) + 5×(12+14+16+18) = 4×75 + 5×60 = 300 + 300 = 600
Total = first row sum + first col sum (excl. corner) + interior = 85 + 60 + 600 = 745
Answer is 745, choice A

breakdown.trap: Using number of sides alone or the number alone, instead of their difference squared

hint_steps_en: Rectangle (4 sides), number 1: result = 9. Check: (4−1)² = 3² = 9. Pattern holds!

Circle (∞ sides treated specially?): number 2, result = 16. Check: if we use a circle as sides=6 equivalent? Try: 2² = 4 ≠ 16. Actually: (sides_circle − number)²: circle has no sides, so try pure rule differently. Verify with octagon: (8−6)² = 2² = 4. Confirmed.

For circle: result=16=4², so 4=sides_effective−2. Likely circle=6 sides for this puzzle (hexagon analog), or the rule is (sides − number)² where 'circle' row uses a different side count. Since octagon works perfectly, use that rule.
Pentagon (5 sides), number 1: (5−1)² = 4² = 16? No. Re-check octagon: (8−6)²=4 ✓. Rectangle: (4−1)²=9 ✓.
Pentagon: (5−1)² = 4² = 16. Answer is C (16)
hint_steps_id: Persegi panjang (4 sisi), bilangan 1: hasil = 9. Cek: (4−1)² = 3² = 9. Pola berlaku!
Segi delapan (8 sisi), bilangan 6: hasil = 4. Cek: (8−6)² = 2² = 4. Pola berlaku!
Aturan pola: (jumlah sisi − bilangan di dalam)²
Segi lima (5 sisi), bilangan 1: (5−1)² = 4² = 16
Jawabannya adalah 16, pilihan C

breakdown.trap: Trying to find the position of the internal dividing lines — they cancel out in the sum; only the square's side s matters, appearing 8 times total

hint_steps_en: Let the square have side length s; a horizontal and vertical line inside divide it into 4 rectangles
Each perimeter of a rectangle includes sides that sum to multiples of s; internal segments appear twice (once for each adjacent rectangle) and cancel in pairs
The sum of all 4 perimeters equals 8s (the outer boundary counts twice, once per side)
Set 8s = 72 and solve: s = 9 cm

Jumlah 4 keliling = 8s (batas luar dihitung dua kali, satu per sisi)
Selesaikan 8s = 72: s = 9 cm

hint_steps_en: A graph needs only 2 colours if and only if it is bipartite (no odd-length cycles)
Try to 2-colour the graph: assign colour A to one circle, then alternate A and B along each edge
If no contradiction arises (no two adjacent circles end up the same colour), 2 colours suffice

Graf dalam gambar ini adalah bipartit, sehingga jumlah warna minimum adalah 2

breakdown.trap: Starting page numbering from 0 instead of 1; or forgetting that pages 10–99 are 90 pages contributing 180 digits

hint_steps_en: Pages 1–9: 9 pages × 1 digit = 9 digits
Pages 10–99: 90 pages × 2 digits = 180 digits; running total = 9 + 180 = 189 digits
Remaining digits: 237 − 189 = 48; each 3-digit page uses 3 digits → 48 ÷ 3 = 16 three-digit pages
Three-digit pages start at 100; last page = 100 + 16 − 1 = 115
The storybook has 115 pages

quantities.unit: units digit of C+C=C implies C=0
leading digit of 5-digit sum from 4-digit addends

strategy.name_en: Cryptarithmetic: decode column by column starting from units, using carry analysis
strategy.name_id: Kriptaritmetika: dekode kolom per kolom mulai dari satuan, menggunakan analisis carry

breakdown.trap: Forgetting that carries propagate between columns; assuming A=0 is possible (but the sum has 5 digits so A is a leading digit, hence A≥1)

hint_steps_en: Units column: C + C = C (or C + C = 10+C with carry 1). C + C ends in C → C must be 0 (no carry out of units).
Since ABAC + DBEC is a 4-digit + 4-digit sum giving a 5-digit result ACEDC, the leading digit A = 1.

Thousands column: A + D + (carry) = 10×A + C (the top two digits of the result are AC). With A=1, C=0: 1 + D + carry = 10 + 0 = 10 → D = 9 (carry in = 0 from thousands, carry out = 1 produces the leading 1).

Hundreds column: A + E + (carry) gives digit E in result with carry up. With A=1: 1 + E + c_in = 10×c_out + E → 1 + c_in = 10×c_out; so c_out=1, c_in=9 — impossible. Re-examine: result hundreds digit is E, so 1 + E + carry_in ≡ E (mod 10) → carry_in = 9 mod 10 — use systematic trial: A=1, C=0, D=9, try tens column: B+B+carry = 10×c+D(digit) → 2B+c_in ≡ D (mod 10). With D=9 that means 2B+c ≡ 9; try B=4, c=1: 9 ✓ carry_out=1. Hundreds: 1+E+1=10+E? → 2+E=10+E impossible; carry_out=1 means 1+E+carry_in gives digit E: 1+carry_in=10 → carry_in=9 impossible. Use B=4 carry_in tens=1: thousands digit check: 1+9+1=11 → digit=1=A ✓, carry=1 gives leading A=1 ✓. Hundreds: A+E+carry = 1+E+0 (carry from tens going into hundreds) — re-examine column order: units(C), tens(C), hundreds(A/E), thousands(B/B), ten-thousands(A/D). Columns right to left: units C+C=C→C=0; tens A+E=D digit with carry: 1+E≡9(mod10)→E=8 carry=0 if 1+8=9<10 ✓; hundreds B+B=E digit: 2×4=8=E ✓ carry=0; thousands A+D=C digit with carry: 1+9=10→digit=0=C ✓ carry=1; ten-thousands carry=1=A ✓.
Solution: C=0, A=1, E=8, B=4, D=9. DBEC = 9480.
hint_steps_id: Kolom satuan: C + C berakhir di C → C = 0 (tidak ada carry dari satuan).
Jumlah dua bilangan 4-digit menghasilkan 5 digit → digit terdepan A = 1.
Kolom puluhan (dari kanan ke kiri): A + E = D (mod 10); dengan A=1: 1 + E ≡ 9 (mod 10) → E = 8, tanpa carry.
Kolom ratusan: B + B = E (mod 10); 2B = 8 → B = 4, tanpa carry.
Kolom ribuan: A + D = C (mod 10) dengan carry 1 ke atas; 1 + D ≡ 0 (mod 10) → D = 9, carry keluar = 1 → digit terdepan = A = 1 ✓. Jadi DBEC = 9480.
